subject.title: Illustrative case: digitizing a national food subsidy
subject.context: Hypothetical teaching case. A ministry replaces paper bread-and-fuel vouchers with a biometric, ID-linked smart card during a tight budget cycle. All names, figures and sources are illustrative.
subject.question: Who gains power when a subsidy moves from paper vouchers to an algorithmic smart card, and which official claims survive evidence review?
subject.executive_thesis: The reform verifiably changes the tools and the enrolled population; the fiscal motive is a structural inference; the headline fraud figure is an unverified institutional claim.

interests.name: Cut the subsidy bill before budget review
interests.rationale: Launch timing coincides with the budget review; motive inferred from the fiscal calendar, not stated in any document.

actors.name: Ministry, card contractor, 2.1M households
actors.rationale: The ministry, its payment-card contractor and the enrolled household register are named in the published procurement record.

tools.name: Biometric card + eligibility formula
tools.rationale: The decree text specifies biometric enrolment and a points-based eligibility formula.

narrative.name: Card will cut fraud by 40%
narrative.rationale: The 40% figure appears only in a press release; no method, baseline or dataset is published.

results.name: 1 in 11 eligible homes failed enrolment
results.power_balance_impact: shifted toward the administering ministry and contractor
results.rationale: The pilot audit reports enrolment failures among households that met the eligibility criteria.

feedback.description: Complaints force new municipal appeal desks
feedback.rationale: Appeal desks extend the actor set; causal link to complaints is inferred from sequence, not confirmed.

items.rhetoric: The card will reach every family in need.
actions: Pilot audit shows 1 in 11 eligible households failed biometric enrolment
No appeal channel existed at launch
items.interpretation: Universal-reach rhetoric coexists with a measurable exclusion error built into the enrolment tool.

items.name: Exclusion becomes the hidden saving
early_signals: Subsidy spend falls faster than fraud findings
disproven_if: Audited fraud reduction explains most of the spending drop
items.rationale: If savings outpace documented fraud, exclusion error is a plausible contributor.

items.claim: The ministry, a named card contractor and 2.1M enrolled households are the system's actors.
items.source_title: Illustrative: public procurement contract and enrolment register
items.source_note: Hypothetical primary record used for teaching.
items.uncertainty: Low; names and counts are stated in the record.

items.claim: The reform is driven by the need to cut the subsidy bill before the budget review.
items.source_note: Motive inferred from timing; no document states it.
items.uncertainty: Timing is consistent with the motive but does not prove it.
items.counter_evidence: The ministry cites service quality, not cost, as the goal.

items.claim: Eligibility is decided by biometric enrolment plus a points-based formula.
The card will cut subsidy fraud by 40%.
items.source_note: Asserted figure; no method, baseline or dataset published.
items.uncertainty: High; the figure cannot be reproduced.

items.claim: In the pilot, 1 in 11 eligible households failed enrolment.
items.uncertainty: Pilot regions may not represent the national rollout.
items.counter_evidence: Enrolment improved in the final pilot month.

items.claim: Appeal desks were added because of exclusion complaints.
items.source_title: Illustrative: complaint log and ministerial circular timeline
items.source_note: Sequence of events suggests, but does not confirm, the causal link.
items.uncertainty: Other drivers (court rulings, donor pressure) are possible.
items.counter_evidence: The circular does not mention complaints.

items.assumption: Pilot enrolment failure rates carry over to the national rollout.
items.disproving_test: National enrolment audit shows a failure rate under 2%.
items.implication_if_wrong: The exclusion result weakens and the contradiction severity drops.

quality_gate.next_improvement: Teaching case only: every source is illustrative and unverified, so the repo's publication gate stays blocked by design.
